''' Related Zones: ''' | Various |- ! ''' Related NPCs: ''' | Various |} Dreadscale is a quested set of armor for [[Iksar]] [[Shadow Knight]]s. The various pieces require you to traverse much of Kunark to complete. Both are located in the bottom of the Eastern Tower for Shaman and Shadow Knight building. A full set (2 bracers) gives a total of 91 AC, +12str, +22sta, +3agi, +13dex, +10int, +10HP, +16sv Magic, +9sv Fire, +9sv Cold, +10sv Disease, +10sv Poison. == Rewards == ==== Sirtha Scarscale ==== {{Gear Set |Dreadscale Helm |Dreadscale Gauntlets |Dreadscale Boots |Dreadscale Vambraces }} ==== Sarth Scarscale ==== {{Gear Set |Dreadscale Bracer |Dreadscale Mask |Dreadscale Greaves |Dreadscale Breastplate }} == Walkthrough == Note: There is no faction reward for doing these quests === [[Sirtha Scarscale]] === You say, 'Hail, Sirtha Scarscale' Sirtha Scarscale eyes you intently. 'So, yet another hatchling approaches us. I am known as Sirtha and that is Sarth. We are of [Rile's] children. Who do you call your father, broodling?' You say, 'I am a child of Rile' Sirtha Scarscale says, 'Very good. We are smiths for the Crusaders of the Greenmist and I shall make [armor] for you, provided you prove your worth. Fail these simple tasks, and you shall not be worthy to bear the title of crusader!' You say, 'what armor' Sirtha Scarscale says, 'I will make [helms], [gauntlets], [boots], and [vambraces]. My broodmate shall make the bracers, greaves, masks, and breastplate.' ==== Dreadscale Helm ===={{CheckboxList}} You say, 'what helms' Sirtha Scarscale says, 'The sarnak are a mockery of the Iksar. They are nothing more than beasts fit only to do our bidding! I require you to bring me the sword of one of their Order of Knights and the head of a sarnak berserker. These beasts have been attacking our patrols of late. I also require a stone called a ruby and a banded helm. Do this and I shall make a helm for you.' Requires: * 1x [[Sarnak Berserker Head]] - Dropped [[Overthere]] (Level 30-33) * 1x [[Sarnak Knight's Sword]] - Dropped from [[a sarnak knight]] in [[Burning Wood]] (Level 33-37) * 1x [[Ruby]] - Bought * 1x [[Banded Helm]] - Crafted ==== Dreadscale Gauntlets ==== You say, 'what gauntlets' Sirtha Scarscale says, 'I currently have need of a complete skeletal hand, for the research I am conducting. I wish to study its properties and form so that I can make gauntlets befitting our station. I also require two rubies that holds stars within and some banded gauntlets to complete my ritual. Do that and the gauntlets are yours to keep.' Requires: * 1x [[Skeletal Hand]] - Dropped from [[charbone skeleton]] in [[Lake of Ill Omen]] (Level 23-27) * 2x [[Star Ruby]] - Bought * 1x [[Banded Gauntlets]] - Crafted ==== Dreadscale Boots ==== You say, 'what boots' Sirtha Scarscale says, 'Cactus quills can be very lethal. I seek to work them into my new boots. Find me these quills, a pair of skeletal feet, an emerald of fire, and some banded boots so that I may start working on them. Why are you still here?! Begone!' Requires: * 1x [[Cactus Quills]] - Dropped [[Overthere]] (Level 31-33) * 1x [[Skeletal Feet]] - Dropped [[Kurn's Tower]] (Level 15, but to get to the mob you need a group/duo in upper teens) * 1x [[Fire Emerald]] - Bought * 1x [[Banded Boots]] - Crafted ==== Dreadscale Vambraces ==== You say, 'what vambraces' Sirtha Scarscale says, 'The hideous Golra are hardy creatures. The tales indicate their ferocity almost matches our own. I wish to gain a trophy of one of these beasts. Bring me the skin of one, two blue sapphires, and banded sleeves. Then I shall give you these fine vambraces.' Requires: * 1x [[Golra Skin]] - Dropped [[Timorous Deep]] (Level 34-35) * 2x [[sapphire]] - Bought * 1x [[Banded Sleeves]] - Crafted == [[Sarth Scarscale]] == You say, 'Hail, Sarth Scarscale' Sarth Scarscale hisses at you loudly. 'So, you [bear the mantle of a crusader], yes? I am known as Sarth and shall reward you, provided you prove your worthiness to our cause, child of Rile.' You say, 'I will bear the mantle of a crusader' Sarth Scarscale says, 'We shall see if you are worthy of that. I shall make [armor] for you, to aid you in your service to our Father. I specialize in the forging of [bracers], [greaves], [masks], and [breastplates]. Sirtha makes the other items of armor. Take care when you address her, hatchling, it would not be the first time a hatchling has left here with scars.' ==== Dreadscale Bracer ==== You say, 'what bracers' Sarth Scarscale says, 'Have you ever seen Bloodgills? I hear they will devour a broodling in seconds and that their scales are tough as iron. Bring me some of these scales, a banded bracer, and a sapphire as blue as the sky. Only then will I give the bracer to you, broodling. Requires: * 1x [[:Bloodgill Scales]] - Dropped [[Lake of Ill Omen]] (Level 35-39) * 1x [[sapphire]] - Bought * 1x [[:Banded Bracer]] - Crafted ==== Dreadscale Greaves ==== You say, 'what greaves' Sarth Scarscale says, 'Do you know the beasts that call themselves sarnaks? One such beast who calls itself Zorash attacked an envoy of merchants who were to deliver a pair of special boots to me. It taunts us by wearing them as a trophy. Bring them back and the skull of Grachnist, his goblin ally. Return them to me along with a star ruby and your banded greaves, and I shall craft you an excellent pair of greaves.' Requires: * 1x [[:Grachnist's Head]] - Dropped [[Warsliks Woods]] (Level 32) * 1x [[:Boots of Zorash]] - Dropped [[Overthere]] (Level 37) * 1x [[Star Ruby]] - Bought * 1x [[:Banded Leggings]] - Crafted ==== Dreadscale Mask ==== You say, 'what mask' Sarth Scarscale says, 'Have you ever encountered a drixie before? I crush every one I see. They are an annoyance beyond mere words! Kill the Queen and bring me her wings as a trophy along with an emerald of fire and a banded mask.' Requires: * 1x [[Wings of the Drixie Queen]] - Dropped [[Firiona Vie]] (Level 25) * 1x [[Fire Emerald]] - Bought * 1x [[Banded Mask]] - Crafted ==== Dreadscale Breastplate ==== You say, 'what breastplate' Sarth Scarscale says, 'Ahhhh....a breastplate you want, is it? Well, they are not easy to come by. Fetch me a scorpion chitin. Intact, mind you! They are extremely fragile and must be treated before they can protect your carcass. Also, fetch me a war braid from a sarnak to connect the pieces. I also require a ruby and your banded tunic. Do this and I shall make it for you, hatchling. Now, go!' Requires: * 1x [[Scorpion Chitin]] - Dropped [[Field of Bone]] (Level 17) * 1x [[Sarnak War Braid]] - Dropped [[Overthere]] (Level 31-33) * 1x [[ruby]] - Bought * 1x [[Banded Mail]] - Crafted [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:East Cabilis]] [[Category:Shadow Knight Quests]]
